say:3:1510868001:0.text: What... what did you do to me?!

say:4:1510868002:0.text: I broke the spell. The one the Hunting Goddess placed on you.
say:4:1510868002:0.source_cn: 帮你解开了狩猎神施加的神力。

say:5:1510868003:1.text: So now what—you're saying Gorgonna lied to me? Or the Hunting Goddess did?
say:5:1510868003:1.source_cn: 所以你们到底想说什么？是露骗了我，还是狩猎神骗了我？

choice_prompt:6:1510868003.text: So now what—you're saying Gorgonna lied to me? Or the Hunting Goddess did?
choice_prompt:6:1510868003.source_cn: 所以你们到底想说什么？是露骗了我，还是狩猎神骗了我？

say:11:1510868007:1.text: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!
say:11:1510868007:1.source_cn: ……这只是你一面之词，我没办法求证。何况你不仅欺骗呼临...
say:11:1510868007:1.male: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!
say:11:1510868007:1.female: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!

choice_prompt:12:1510868007.text: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!

choice_prompt:12:1510868007.male: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!
choice_prompt:12:1510868007.female: You expect me to believe that based on your word? You've deceived both the Halians and the Wildborn before!

say:13:1510868008:0.text: Listen, Perseus. You're caught in a dream—wrapped in a lie sweet enough to ignore the truth. We aren't forcing you to believe us.
say:13:1510868008:0.source_cn: 听着，珀尔修斯。你沉于重获爱情的甜蜜，不愿相信露就是狩...

say:14:1510868009:0.text: But we're not lying. The goddess herself gave the order—the Wildborn have already begun their <style="highlight">full-scale assault</style>. She's blessed every one of their warriors.

say:15:1510868010:0.text: You know how thin Halia's forces are—starved and worn. They can't stand against divinely empowered soldiers.
say:15:1510868010:0.source_cn: 你应当清楚饥荒下的呼临士兵，和雅库伯尔战士的差距。遑论...

say:16:1510868011:0.text: I've raised magical wards to slow the Wildborn, but that will only hold the Wildborn army off for a short time.
say:16:1510868011:0.source_cn: 为稳定战局，我在战场上设下了魔法墙。但那只能暂时阻挡雅...

say:17:1510868012:0.text: I'll show you the battlefield. See it for yourself, then you'll know what you must do.
say:17:1510868012:0.source_cn: 我会为你展示战场的现状，看过后，你就会知道自己该做出怎...

choice:12:0:1.text: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我说过我不是，他们不听！
choice:12:0:1.male: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.
choice:12:0:1.female: I tried to tell the truth, they didn't listen.

choice:12:1:2.text: I was put on the spot!
choice:12:1:2.male: I was put on the spot!
choice:12:1:2.female: I was put on the spot!

choice:9:0:1.text: She called your name when she descended.
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 狩猎神降临时呼唤了你的名字
choice:9:0:1.male: She called your name when she descended.
choice:9:0:1.female: She called your name when she descended.

choice:9:1:2.text: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 雅库伯尔根本没让露去活祭！
choice:9:1:2.male: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.
choice:9:1:2.female: She wasn't used as a sacrifice.

choice:9:2:3.female: The goddess likes taking different forms.
